current_evidence: Could not confirm: the checklist PDF is robots-disallowed, the council's 'local-validation-checklist' page (listed in Grokbot's docs_read) now returns a client error, and the 'documents-and-forms' page that 'making-a-planning-application' points to no longer shows a validation checklist link; searches turned up no other official copy.

issues.detail: The council's own pages no longer clearly link the checklist. 'Making a planning application' says to download the Validation Checklist from the Documents and Forms page, but that page now lists only 'Public Participation Procedure' and 'Guidance on Location and Block Plans'. The /local-validation-checklist page that Grokbot read returns an error. The list may have moved or been withdrawn, so it needs a manual check.
issues.evidence: documents-and-forms page: no validation checklist or local list document linked

issues.detail: Four 'Submission rules' tab items are process text, not requirements: Planning Portal 10MB file limit, submitting documents on CD, redaction of personal information, and confidentiality of financial information.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'We will redact any personal information such as private signatures...'; 'when submitting such documents on CD...'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled because the table columns were merged during extraction. For example, Ecological Survey and HRA share an identical jumbled excerpt that mixes the SPA/SAC/SSSI trigger with guidance text, and the Flood Risk, Affordable Housing, Biodiversity, Air Quality and Drainage excerpts have interleaved columns. One drawing-standards item is cut off ('They should be to a recognised paper size, e.g.').
issues.evidence: 'Special Protection Area (SPA), Special Area of Protected species survey reports should provide Conservation (SAC), the Council with sufficient Ramsar Site...'

issues.detail: About 24 requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' and none appear under Outline or Reserved matters, which show '(none)', although the checklist applies requirements such as FRA, Affordable Housing and Tree Survey by development type, not only to Full applications. Sequential/Exception Test is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the quoted text actually exempts change of use applications.
issues.evidence: '...for all development other than change of use applications'

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' and 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' come from general introductory text (advice on pre-app discussions; reference to the EIA Regulations 2011), not from local list entries.
issues.evidence: 'Pre-application discussions with the Planning Officer can help...'; 'The Town and Country Planning (EIA) ... Regulations 2011'

summary: I could not fetch the source: the PDF is blocked by robots and the council's checklist page now errors, so I could not check whether the list is current or compare its contents. Grokbot's own extraction contains process text, garbled multi-column triggers and blanket 'Full planning' placements, and its date comes from PDF metadata.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The list date 2025-04-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not from an adoption or publication date in the document text, so the real adoption date of the checklist is unknown.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The date is supported by the text. The PDF cover reads 'Validation Checklist April 2025' (raw 1d8d40920d), and the council page says the list came 'into effect on the 21st April 2025', so 2025-04-01 is correct at month precision. Only the basis label should change.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.
